description:
Get the crypto market at a glance in one call: the Crypto Fear & Greed Index (today, yesterday, a week ago), BTC, ETH and SOL with perp price, 24h change, funding and Chainlink reference price, the highest and lowest funding rates, the biggest 24h gainers and losers, and Hyperliquid's total open interest and volume.

$0.003 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.
